name: A break with the Consortium

date.label: The Burning Crusade · quest sequence; exact date unknown

summary: Khay’ji describes the Zaxxis as ethereals who left the Consortium and made dealings with the Sunfury. He says he infiltrated their camp at the Heap and took out their leader, but had to escape to Area 52. The quest sends the seeker back for Zaxxis insignias. Their collection records evidence of the break, not a new treaty or a full account of why the group left. Khay’ji’s report is the story’s only account of his failed operation.
